def neighbor_list(site, N):
    '''Return all nearest neighbors of site (i, j).
    Args:
        site (Tuple[int, int]): site indices
        N (int): number of sites along each dimension
    Return:
        list: a list of 2-tuples, [(i_left, j_left), (i_above, j_above), (i_right, j_right), (i_below, j_below)]
    '''
    i, j = site
    # Apply periodic boundary conditions using modulo
    i_left = (i - 1) % N
    j_above = (j + 1) % N
    i_right = (i + 1) % N
    j_below = (j - 1) % N
    return [(i_left, j), (i, j_above), (i_right, j), (i, j_below)]

# Test cases
# Test 1: Normal site (not at boundaries)
result1 = neighbor_list((2, 3), 5)
print("Test 1 - Site (2,3) in 5x5:", result1)
assert result1 == [(1, 3), (2, 4), (3, 3), (2, 2)]

# Test 2: At left boundary (i=0)
result2 = neighbor_list((0, 2), 5)
print("Test 2 - Site (0,2) in 5x5:", result2)
assert result2 == [(4, 2), (0, 3), (1, 2), (0, 1)]

# Test 3: At top boundary (j=0)
result3 = neighbor_list((3, 0), 5)
print("Test 3 - Site (3,0) in 5x5:", result3)
assert result3 == [(2, 0), (3, 1), (4, 0), (3, 4)]

# Test 4: At bottom boundary (j=N-1)
result4 = neighbor_list((3, 4), 5)
print("Test 4 - Site (3,4) in 5x5:", result4)
assert result4 == [(2, 4), (3, 0), (4, 4), (3, 3)]

# Test 5: At corner (0, 0)
result5 = neighbor_list((0, 0), 5)
print("Test 5 - Site (0,0) in 5x5:", result5)
assert result5 == [(4, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, 4)]

# Test 6: At opposite corner (N-1, N-1)
result6 = neighbor_list((4, 4), 5)
print("Test 6 - Site (4,4) in 5x5:", result6)
assert result6 == [(3, 4), (4, 0), (0, 4), (4, 3)]

print("All tests passed!")
</parameter>
